description: This file manages ControllerRevisions in Kubernetes, including creation, hashing, sorting, adoption, release, and listing of revisions, with support for indexing and fake implementations for testing.

classes.name: byRevision
classes.description: A type implementing sort.Interface to sort ControllerRevisions by their Revision field.

methods.name: ControllerRevisionControllerIndexKey
methods.description: Generates an index key for ControllerRevisions based on namespace and ownerReference.

methods.name: AddControllerRevisionControllerIndexer
methods.description: Adds an indexer to efficiently look up ControllerRevisions by their controller owner reference.

methods.name: ControllerRevisionName
methods.description: Constructs a ControllerRevision name with a prefix and hash, truncating prefix if necessary.

methods.name: NewControllerRevision
methods.description: Creates a new ControllerRevision object with specified parent, labels, data, revision, and collision count.

methods.name: HashControllerRevision
methods.description: Computes a hash of the ControllerRevision's Data for versioning and uniqueness.

methods.name: SortControllerRevisions
methods.description: Sorts a list of ControllerRevisions by their Revision number and creation timestamp.

methods.name: EqualRevision
methods.description: Checks semantic equality of two ControllerRevisions based on their Data.

methods.name: FindEqualRevisions
methods.description: Finds all ControllerRevisions in a list that are equal to a given revision.

methods.name: ListControllerRevisions
methods.description: Lists all ControllerRevisions owned by a parent object matching a label selector.

methods.name: CreateControllerRevision
methods.description: Creates a new ControllerRevision, handling name collisions via hashing and collision count.

methods.name: UpdateControllerRevision
methods.description: Updates the Revision number of a ControllerRevision, retrying on conflicts.

methods.name: AdoptControllerRevision
methods.description: Adds a ControllerRef to a ControllerRevision to adopt it under a parent object.

methods.name: ReleaseControllerRevision
methods.description: Removes a parent owner reference from a ControllerRevision.
